criteria_status: proposed engineering acceptance criteria; not a certified standard or measured result

definition_gates.needed: Approved WPS, post-weld datum/thread inspection and weld quality record for B06-W01
Actual Phoenix mate/RJ45 latch/SMA/ground lug/cable samples; fit, release, bend and strain-relief geometry checked
Final power/ground/RJ45/dual coax and INTERNAL5V-PWM harness lengths, routing, clamps/crimp inspection; no dedicated desk-box5V lead

Continuous/peak48V current, PoC and GMSL mode fixed and protection/fuse coordination reviewed; connector current is not PCB current rating; local48V-to5V/PWM supply design, native PCB layout, branch protection, transient/ripple and low-load regulation qualification required
Actual PETG/transparent material/process, shrink compensation, captive nuts, lamp shim and optical recipe
Loading apparatus inspected and calibrated, rated load-pin/clevis/lifting accessory, restraint and stiffness known
Complete drawings/BOM/harness/native PCB version frozen, first-article and repeat-build review approved; close native schematic warnings and complete actual connector-model review

tests.method: CMM/height gauge of metal first article, flange, W01 datums and all thread gauges
tests.conditions: Compare current STEP and feature table; 100% critical mating holes/threads

tests.method: Full base assembly with lamp/IO/clamp; captive-nut fit, tool access, surface quality and exposed sharp-edge inspection
tests.conditions: Actual printed material and hardware, no arm; perform10 assemble/service cycles

tests.method: Actual mating plugs, latches, coax wrench and rear cover service
tests.conditions: 20 insert/remove cycles per port; unplug, remove two rear screws, rearward40mm then lift; record real wall clearance

tests.method: Calibrate AF6 tightening torque against measured clamp force, then inspect actual desk surfaces
tests.conditions: Separate15/30/60mm flat desks; each rod load-cell calibrated before loading; no published3.6Nm assumption

tests.method: Standalone fixture apply +/-X and +/-Y bending at Z558; ramp25/50/75/100% of150Nm, hold60s each
tests.conditions: Each15/30/60mm qualified desk, restraint fitted; subtract apparatus compliance; inspect unloaded datum

tests.method: Independent500N axial down and100N horizontal loads, each hold60s; characterize compliance
tests.conditions: Separate cases; not a claim of simultaneous combined loading; fixture/self-weight tared

tests.method: Calibrated torque drive on test-post AF24 apply+/-40Nm yaw; hold60s each direction
tests.conditions: Record flange/desk angle, fastener marking and preload; apparatus approved first

tests.method: 180x150x50mm dummy mass3kg, centre and four extreme permitted positions; hold24h, remove front stop and extract toward+Y
tests.conditions: Actual strap/stops, no external-box electronics needed; independently secured dummy

tests.method: Unpowered100% connector mapping/short check, RJ45 pin1..8 and shield,48V polarity, CAM-A/B, lamp1/2/3
tests.conditions: All external supplies disconnected; VIN/RETURN/CHASSIS remain distinct except documented bench grounding

tests.method: Four-wire chassis-bond resistance J6 to each exposed intended metal member
tests.conditions: Document approved bond washers/lug/finish masking; CHASSIS test does not establish protective-earth class

tests.method: 48V externally fused/current-limited supply to electronic load at J4/J5; ramp to declared continuous current
tests.conditions: Requires finalized current rating; worst accepted ambient/enclosure/box heat, stabilized at<1degC change over15min; log every contact and copper

tests.method: Declared peak current waveform and external short-circuit protection review/test on instrumented bench
tests.conditions: Requires peak duration and coordinated fuse/source limit; no hotplug; protection/connector/copper stress limits reviewed before energizing

tests.method: Regulated4.75/5.00/5.25V bench +3.3/5V PWM;0/25/50/75/100% duty at1kHz, current, optical output and source reset
tests.conditions: Temporary GH3-core lead to bench, branch limit100mA; never48V; record lens/shim/material recipe; lamp-only stage may use temporary bench source; final assembled stage MUST run from local base5V at its declared input extremes and off/full/PWM/startup conditions

tests.method: Run programmed breath/flash sequences under closed cover for8h, then service and inspect PCB/lens; verify STM32 firmware hash, UART ACK/error/timeout behavior, nominal1kHz duty, reset-off and watchdog reset on the real board
tests.conditions: Final assembled base uses local48V-to5V supply and implemented programmable PWM; no arm dependency or separate desk-box5V lead; temporary external PWM only verifies lamp subassembly and does not qualify complete base

tests.method: Commercial standalone slave + external master, real EtherCAT process data and error-counter trace through base J1/J2
tests.conditions: Freeze master NIC/driver/slave/cable and1ms cycle,8h; retain direct bypass baseline; ordinary ping is not this test

tests.method: Calibrated VNA/TDR with actual intended cables, CAM-A/B and bypass baseline
tests.conditions: Sweep to Nyquist of frozen GMSL mode and serializer-required band; record insertion/return loss against vendor channel mask;18GHz connector alone is insufficient

tests.method: Two standalone serializer/camera test-pattern channels + external receiver, optionally approved PoC; no arm needed
tests.conditions: Freeze GMSL mode/cables/receiver and8h streams under loaded power/lamp PWM; thermal and frame-error logging

tests.method: Power-load, lamp PWM, EtherCAT and dual sensor bench simultaneously, closed base and budget box heat
tests.conditions: 8h at frozen rated configuration; inspect noise, temperature and functional error counters; no arm

tests.method: Mechanically independent repetitive fixture loading, dedicated restrained endurance bench
tests.conditions: Proposed10000 cycles0..50Nm bending at0.2Hz, then repeat M05/M06/M07; duty and life target must be approved before production release

tests.method: Repeat-build3 independent bases from controlled drawings/BOM/process, complete functional end-of-line mapping/light/bond tests
tests.conditions: First article plus repeatability evidence; sample count is engineering pilot, not statistical lifetime qualification

tests.method: Independent current-limited48V supply, electronic load and calibrated oscilloscope; no arm or camera needed
tests.conditions: 43.2/48/52.8V; LED off with470ohm bleed then100mA external5V load; cold/hot start and load steps; record waveform, actual effective input capacitance, temperature and fault/inrush evidence; external supply limited; no PWM controller qualification inferred
